description: Create a new Custom Data Type in OneUptime. Returns the created Custom Data Type object with its ID. Use this to add new Custom Data Types to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

ignoreCase.description: Whether the pattern ignores upper and lower case.

isEnabled.description: Whether scans look for this data type.

keywords.description: Words that, near a value, confirm it is this type.

name.description: The data type's name, such as Employee ID.

nameHints.description: Field, column and attribute names that hold this type, such as employee id.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression for one value. Leave empty to find it from field names alone.
pattern.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

projectId.description: ID of the project this custom data type belongs to.

requiresKeyword.description: Count a value only when a keyword is nearby or the field's name hints at the type.

sensitivity.description: How sensitive it is: Restricted, Confidential, Internal or Public.

validator.description: A checksum a value must pass: None, Luhn, Mod97 or Verhoeff.

name: create_custom_data_type
title: Create Custom Data Type
